invariants.rationale: A non-null instantTime is generally required to identify the timeline instant for commit operations.
The list of hoodie records to insert must not be null to proceed with the operation.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is necessary to execute engine operations.
A List is either empty or has size > 0; this captures the mutually exclusive exhaustive states for preppedRecords.
The Option type itself should not be null, representing the presence/absence of a BulkInsertPartitioner.
